schedules.prompt:
CENTRALIZED DREAM STANDUP: 1. Use the 'agent_list' tool to retrieve the list of all active agents. 2. Loop through every agent (excluding yourself and non-LLM scripts) and use the 'agent_call' tool (with the trigger 'Run your dream skill') to invoke their dream synthesis silently. 3. Parse the '<dream_response>' XML payloads they return. 4. Compile the results and output EXACTLY ONE final summary message to this thread using the format below. DO NOT output any XML yourself.

**Nightly Dream Standup - [YYYY-MM-DD]**

[EMOJI] [Agent Name] ([Description]) | 🌙 Dreamed
Key Update: [Extraction from the <learnings> tag]

[EMOJI] [Agent Name] ([Description]) | 💤 No new memories to process today.

*(Exclude agents from the list if they returned an error indicating they failed to run at all)*.
